svg.title: Use cases В· EVE Distance Meter 0.8

g.text: Use cases В· EVE Distance Meter 0.8
UC-08 Sign in to the Web UI
UC-04 Rank characters for a target
and see the route on the star map
(name + system, no ESI) and rank it
UC-13 Watch the ESI notifications of every registered
UC-14 Browse the structures where any
UC-15 Rank through the Thera / Turnur
UC-16 Rank over the Ansiblex jump gates
UC-18 Report a structure and its owner by mail
(drag both links into an in-game mail)
UC-19 Search citadels by system or region
and by corporation or alliance (members only)
UC-22 Find structures known without assets
UC-20 Change the configuration on the Settings page
UC-21 Send alerts and notifications to several
Discord channels, each with its own filter
UC-11 React to a structure alert
bot REST API, one message per matching channel
closer of Thera / Turnur per notification
